subject: Creating a myDiff bed file to feed into eDMR

messages.author: 0490c034b26c6223
messages.subject: Creating a myDiff bed file to feed into eDMR
parts:
My input files are tab delimited text files that look like the following without headers.

chr start end strand coverage %_methylation

I will feed three files into methylKit using the following commands:
#MethylKit Working Script
library(methylKit)

obj=read("NO19_methylKit.txt",sample.id="NO19",assembly="hg19",header=TRUE, context="CpG", resolution="base",
          pipeline=list(fraction=TRUE,chr.col=1,start.col=2,end.col=3,
                        strand.col=4, coverage.col=5,freqC.col=6 ),

obj=read("EOC_91_methylKit.txt",sample.id="EOC_91",assembly="hg19",header=TRUE, context="CpG", resolution="base",
          pipeline=list(fraction=TRUE,chr.col=1,start.col=2,end.col=3,
                        strand.col=4, coverage.col=5,freqC.col=6 ),

obj=read("EOC_100_3rd_methylKit.txt",sample.id="EOC_100",assembly="hg19",header=TRUE, context="CpG", resolution="base",
          pipeline=list(fraction=TRUE,chr.col=1,start.col=2,end.col=3,
                        strand.col=4, coverage.col=5,freqC.col=6 ),
       )

# read the files to a methylRawList object: myobj
myobj=read( file.list,
           sample.id=list("NO19","EOC_91","EOC_100"),assembly="hg19",treatment=c(1,0,0))

# get methylation statistics on NO19 in myobj which is a class of methylRawList
getMethylationStats(myobj[[1]],plot=F,both.strands=F)

# plot methylation statistics on NO19 in myobj which is a class of methylRawList
getMethylationStats(myobj[[1]],plot=T,both.strands=F)

# get methylation statistics on EOC_91 in myobj which is a class of methylRawList
getMethylationStats(myobj[[2]],plot=F,both.strands=F)

# plot methylation statistics on EOC_91 in myobj which is a class of methylRawList
getMethylationStats(myobj[[2]],plot=T,both.strands=F)

# get methylation statistics on EOC_100 in myobj which is a class of methylRawList
getMethylationStats(myobj[[3]],plot=F,both.strands=F)

# plot methylation statistics on EOC_100 in myobj which is a class of methylRawList
getMethylationStats(myobj[[3]],plot=T,both.strands=F)

# see what the data looks like for NO19 in myobj methylRawList
head(myobj[[1]])

# see what the data looks like for EOC_91 in myobj methylRawList
head(myobj[[2]])

# see what the data looks like for EOC_100 in myobj methylRawList
head(myobj[[3]])

# merge all samples to one table by using base-pair locations that are covered in all samples
# setting destrand=TRUE, will merge reads on both strans of a CpG dinucleotide. This provides better
# coverage, but only advised when looking at CpG methylation
meth=unite(myobj,destrand=TRUE)

# merge all samples to one table by using base-pair locations that are covered in all samples
#
meth=unite(myobj)

# cluster all samples using correlation distance and return a tree object for plclust
hc = clusterSamples(meth, dist="correlation", method="ward", plot=FALSE)

# plots pair-wise scatter plots from sample set
getCorrelation(meth,plot=TRUE)

# cluster all samples using correlation distance and plot hiarachical clustering
clusterSamples(meth, dist="correlation", method="ward", plot=TRUE)

# plots pair-wise scatter plots from sample set
getCorrelation(meth,plot=TRUE)

# screeplot of principal component analysis.
PCASamples(meth, screeplot=TRUE)

# principal component anlaysis of all samples.
PCASamples(meth)

# calculate differential methylation p-values and q-values
myDiff=calculateDiffMeth(meth)

#########################################################################
At this point I do not know how to create a myDiff bed file with the following format to feed into eDMR

chr start end strand pvalue qvalue meth.diff

##########################################################################

Thanks

Dave

messages.author: e4181d5c40fc094c
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Creating a myDiff bed file to feed into eDMR
parts:
Dear Dave,

eDMR takes two kinds of input. One option is the direct output from 'calculateDiffMeth()' function. Second option is the bed file. Since you are generating 'myDiff' from methylkit, you need not do anything. Just pass 'myDiff' as input into eDMR


Regards,
Kalyan
